reviews.title: Heavy Duty Mag Lite
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] the Energizer Tac 300 with removable clip offers lighting from 50 lumens on the low setting and 5hrs life to a 300 Lumens on the high setting with 2 hrs of usage. It is water resistant and may be seen up to 100 meters of distance.

reviews.title: Lights up like the 4th of July
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This sucker packs a punch,son. I thought being small would be easy for me to carry as I forage early in the morning and at night. Most flashlights are fine and I keep a uv light for mushrooms. I took this out last night and dang near lit up the whole forest. The hubby said it was like a beacon of light from the middle of the trees,lol.

reviews.title: Use battery 😗
reviews.review_text: I bought these for the Lumens as replacement for filament bulbs and for long lasting brightness and long term usage. So far in testing at night compared to 1000 lumens vs 2000 lumens you can see more range with the bigger lumens capacity. I still have the 1000 flashlights and until they no longer functions then I will go the route of getting the 2000 lumens flashlights. I haven't tested the heat from the lens but I know from the 1000 lumens they do get hot if you cover the lens. But I like it comes with a small strap a nice feature but could get entangle if it's with other stuff or backpack. But I like the the Lumens so far and until I find another that is 3000 lumens or higher I think 2000 lumens will be my go to. I do like it comes in two pack a nice value a different buy it someone wants to save and have piece of mind when using in dark places.

reviews.title: Compact & Bright
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] My dog has to take frequent bathroom breaks often during the night time hours and I need a flashlight that will shine very bright in an area that has very limited lighting. The Energizer TAC 300 is very small so that I can tuck it into my jacket and always know where it is when needed. It provides 300 lumens & provides me with enough of a beam to allow me to safely see outdoors. It does include a removable clip which personally I do not use. The push button is easily located and works quite well with 3 modes of lighting. I like the compact size with the powerful beam so will most likely be purchasing more of this product to keep inside automobiles.
